title: Format switch in agent-spec
item: Format switch in the agent-spec skill: claims table, rules in the owner's words, policy model and policy page, scenarios derived from the model, §5 scoring moved out to agent eval
motivation: Owner's problems with the current spec: too dense, 2,000 lines of scenarios to read, tool contract hidden in an appendix, what and how mixed
notes: On agent-spec/switch, merged into re-create-from-scratch (e8ed321; fix rounds d93de6e, 807d36e). Worst of baseline trials 10–12 against the old skill: owner-read lines 221 vs 1,544; time 1,787 s vs 2,103–2,540 s; subagent cost $3.42–4.06 vs about $9.40.
